references.text: God commanded Moses to attack the Midianites because of their treachery against Israel at Peor
The Lord's command to Moses to take vengeance on the Midianites, which verse 7 fulfills
The law to kill all men in a city that refuses peace, parallel to the killing of Midianite men
A similar act where Israel struck everyone under the ban, both men and women, at Jericho
Israel's military victory over Ai where they killed all the inhabitants, following a similar pattern
Israel struck Jabesh in Gilead with the sword and killed all the men, a similar form of warfare
God's command to Saul to strike the Amalekites and kill everything, a parallel divine war order
